messages.text: The second run proves the filter implementation works on mobile, while the desktop worker intermittently retained the unfiltered response; both profiles were mutating the same persisted guest session concurrently, which makes this end-to-end flow nondeterministic. I’m serializing the shared-state browser suite, removing the silent catalog fallback, and selecting the visible title link on mobile where the hover-only preview icon is intentionally absent; these changes test the real responsive contract instead of a desktop-only affordance.
